General/EnvironmentConfig.cls::Load.behavior: missing, malformed or array file raises and clears everything loaded before (U3-U5)

General/EnvironmentConfig.cls::GetArg.behavior: nested lookup; a non-object on the path gives empty (U9)

General/EnvironmentConfig.cls::%Evaluate.behavior: ${VAR} from the OS environment, recursively; value inserted as ICU replacement text (U7, U8)

General/EnvironmentConfig.cls::MergeDyna.behavior: deep merge, arrays by index, scalar replaces object, object onto scalar fails (U2, U6)

Lifecycle/Base.cls::LoadEnvironmentConfi.behavior: clears, then loads each ;-separated file in order, trimmed (U2r, S1)

Utils/LegacyCompat.cls::UpdateSuperclass.behavior: compiles in one process while a configuration is loaded, so generators see it (M3, M4, S3)

General/Singleton.cls::%Get.behavior: the same in-process instance while referenced, so Configure reads what Reload loaded (S1, U10, U11)
